resolution_note: Earth tiles of 1 x 1 deg, weighted by their land area; topography at a common ~463 m pixel on every world; Earth climate on the NASA POWER grids (0.5 x 0.625 deg and 1 deg), 12 months.

sources.Earth topography: Copernicus DEM GLO-90 (ESA), AWS open data
sources.Earth climate: NASA POWER climatology (MERRA-2, CERES SYN1deg), AWS open data
sources.Earth bare ground: ESA WorldCover 10 m 2021 north of 60 S; SCAR Antarctic Digital Database rock outcrop v7.11 south of it (both CC BY 4.0)
sources.Moon: NASA PDS: LRO LOLA, LRO Diviner; NASA PGDA illumination
sources.Mars: NASA PDS: MGS MOLA; Mars Climate Database v6.2 (LMD, with ESA and CNES)

moon_shackleton.diurnal_amp_k: LRO Diviner Global Cumulative Product, Tbol (PDS)
moon_shackleton.temp_min_k: LRO Diviner Global Cumulative Product, Tbol (PDS)
moon_shackleton.aridity: Physics: no liquid water can exist at the surface (vacuum).
moon_shackleton.ice_proxy: Physics: subsurface temperatures stay far below 273 K all year (Diviner, Vasavada et al. 2012).
moon_shackleton.bare_frac: Physics: no vegetation and no snow cover; the surface is regolith and rock (ice in polar cold traps is buried or a trace frost, not a ground cover).
moon_shackleton.insolation_wm2: Computed: horizon method on LRO LOLA topography
moon_shackleton.sunlit_frac: NASA PGDA average illumination map (Mazarico et al. 2011), 120 m; our horizon method on LOLA agrees within W1 = 0.017
moon_shackleton.sun_elevation_deg: Computed: astronomy (latitudes of the window, axial tilt 1.54 deg), smooth sphere, terrain shadows not included

mars_jezero.diurnal_amp_k: Mars Climate Database v6.2 (c) LMD/OU/IAA/ESA/CNES, web interface, climatology scenario with average solar EUV, high-resolution mode: surface temperature at the target centre, 12 seasons x 24 local times. In-situ control: 65-100 K (Perseverance MEDA ground temperature (2021-2023), approximate.); model range over the year 75-95 K.
mars_jezero.temp_min_k: Mars Climate Database v6.2 (c) LMD/OU/IAA/ESA/CNES, web interface, climatology scenario with average solar EUV, high-resolution mode: surface temperature at the target centre, 12 seasons x 24 local times. In-situ control: 175-200 K (Perseverance MEDA ground temperature (2021-2023), approximate.); model range over the year 186-195 K.
mars_jezero.aridity: Physics: no stable liquid water at the surface (pressure near the triple point).
mars_jezero.ice_proxy: Physics: mean annual ground temperature below 240 K at all latitudes.
mars_jezero.bare_frac: Physics: no vegetation; regolith and rock at the surface of the targets (thin seasonal frost is not a permanent cover, as in Earth land-cover maps).
mars_jezero.insolation_wm2: Computed: orbit and obliquity, atmospheric transmission 0.75
mars_jezero.sunlit_frac: Computed: astronomical daylight fraction, no clouds
mars_jezero.sun_elevation_deg: Computed: astronomy (latitudes of the window, axial tilt 25.19 deg), smooth sphere, terrain shadows not included

zoom.note: Sub-areas of about 11 km inside the sites shown with the default settings of each mission profile; same DEM, pixel and operators as the screening; climate stays at tile scale.

subsurface.note: Lava-tube case studies; temperature = annual mean of the NASA POWER cell.

places.note: Country and named physical region of each tile centre; display only, never part of the score. Country lines are Natural Earth's de facto boundaries; no country is given in the areas it lists as disputed.
